name: kb_55_Normalized

schema.description: AzureFile represents an Azure File Service mount on the host and bind mount to the pod.

readOnly.description: Defaults to false (read/write). ReadOnly here will force the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts.

secretName.description: the name of secret that contains Azure Storage Account Name and Key

description: The Azure File volume will be mounted using the secret **azure-storage-secret**, which contains the required Azure Storage account name and key. It will connect to the file share named **myfileshare**, and the mount will be read‑write (the read‑only flag is set to false).
